name: China Railway Hi-tech Industry Corporation Limited
summary: China Railway Hi-tech Industry Corporation Limited manufactures and sells infrastructure construction equipment internationally. The company offers bridge steel structures, shield machine, TBM, profiled shield machine, large special construction machinery, series maglev, and straddle rail transit turnouts and tracks. It engages in the manufacturing and installing of steel structure products; and researches and manufactures railway turnouts, such as turnout, rail, fastening system, fish plate, sleeper, point machine, etc. In addition, the company provides tunnel equipment, including TBM products, tunneling equipment products, rock drill jumbo, and wet shotcrete machines; research, design, and…
